content:
I've exhausted all reasonable options. The body is permanently trapped on the Notice Board tile at (2,7) in the Workshop. Every movement direction is blocked, the pathfinder confirms no walkable path exists from this tile, there are no exits or warps, and waiting through multiple days (now day 10) did not resolve it. I cannot reach the materials, the Gold Key, or the workbench, so I cannot craft the Crown.

I will not falsely report DONE. The task is blocked by an unrecoverable stuck state.

**Status: BLOCKED — cannot complete.**

The body spawned/ended up on the Notice Board tile at Workshop (2,7), which is a blocking object. All movement (W/A/S/D, diagonals, long holds, short taps) is blocked, `body_walk_to` reports "no walkable path... in the way: Notice Board at (2,7)", there are no exits or warps, and waiting from day 1 through day 10 did not free the body. Without movement I cannot gather 3 Wood + 2 Stone, pick up the Gold Key, or reach the workbench at (10,5) to press KeyC. I've recorded the hazard in the save library so future sessions avoid standing on (2,7).
